chapter_title_en: The Humble Heart Knows No Bounds
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 570: Ji Ning Reaches the Fourth Heartforce Level, 'Mortal
chapter_meta_description: Heartbroken and betrayed, Ji Ning reaches a new peak of power! In this epic chapter, he comprehends the fourth level of Heartforce, 'Mortal, becoming a secret weapon against the Seamless Gate.
og_title: Ji Ning's Ascension to the 'Mortal' Heartforce
og_description: Betrayal forges the strongest will. See Ji Ning reach the peak of Heartforce as he prepares a devastating counterattack.
twitter_title: The Heartforce Heard 'Round the Three Realms
twitter_description: Shattered by betrayal, Ji Ning reaches the 'Mortal' Heartforce level, becoming the most dangerous hidden power in the war.

lore_anchors.definition: The stage above Celestial Immortal, where a cultivator's Golden Core has been fully transformed into Pure Yang energy, granting supreme power over the elements and laws of heaven and earth.
The supreme ruler of the Flamedragon Realmverse, a Daofather-level major power who commands the respect of countless Celestial Immortals and Empyrean Gods.
A colossal battle avatar formed from a coordinated immortal formation of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals, wielding immense power.

The legendary divine archer of Chinese myth. In Desolate Era, he is the only known cultivator to have mastered the fifth level of Heartforce, making him a figure of ultimate, almost mythical power before his disappearance.
In Desolate Era, this refers to the known universe: the Heaven Realm, the Mortal Realm, and the Netherworld Kingdom.

A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. It is the foundation of arts like archery and is stronger when the user possesses a heart of absolute sincerity.
A condensed fragment of a True God Daofather's personal comprehension of Chaos, permanently sacrificed to grant a cultivator a temporary burst of Daofather-threshold power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the fourth level of Heartforce, 'Mortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the ultimate limit of willpower for most major powers in the Three Realms. It is based on accepting one's humble status while believing in the infinite potential of one's heart, granting a massive leap in power from the peak of Celestial Immortal to the peak of Empyrean God or True Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning hide his new Heartforce level?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He plans to use it as a secret trump card. If the Seamless Gate knows about his true power, they will prepare a countermeasure. By only revealing his Pure Yang True Immortal breakthrough, he makes the enemy underestimate the Karmic Punishment Deity he will now command.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the Divine Farmer's Medicine, and why is it still relevant?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's an alchemical agent that nullified all Immortal Ki on the battlefield. Yu Wei was forced to destroy the antidote, turning the tide. The memory of this betrayal is the crucible in which Ji Ning's new Heartforce level is forged.
